listing.name: Enchanted Arms — EnchantedArmsPC (IAndrewJJ)
listing.summary: Build Enchanted Arms locally from your Xbox 360 ISO. Upstream reports Windows menus, saves and early gameplay, with character-rendering issues and stutters. A full playthrough and Linux gameplay remain unconfirmed. Portcove has not confirmed setup or gameplay.

steps.title: Check the required game files
steps.instruction: Use your own supported USA or Europe Xbox 360 Enchanted Arms ISO. The exact title ID, media ID and executable hash are not specified in the root README; check the importer and SETUP_TROUBLESHOOTING before preparing files. Game files are not included.

steps.title: Follow upstream setup
steps.instruction: Extract EnchantedArmsPC-0.5.8-windows-x64.zip and open EnchantedArmsLauncher.exe. Select your ISO, choose Build game, then Play. Setup compiles locally, needs an internet connection on first use and uses about 20 GB beyond the ISO. The Linux x86-64 AppImage preview 0.1.0 offers the same ISO and local-build flow.

warnings: Upstream reports Windows save/load, menu and early-game testing, with a full playthrough still in progress. Invisible or incorrectly shaded characters and stutters remain. Gameplay in the Linux preview has not been confirmed on Linux hardware.
Portcove has not confirmed setup, gameplay, saves or updates for this experimental port.
